text:
vivian: dropping a fresh pass on the compact playground controls. main things: streaming stop semantics, tiny rewind scrubber, token pill delta badge, prompt library quick-preview + pin sync. need accessibility + copy + telemetry check before i lock Figma.

tom: nice! quick Q: what should "Stop" do by default? in our research users usually expect partial text to remain. i'd like the CTA short but explicit.

isabel: keep it terse. primary = "Stop"; show a faint caption under the button: "Stops stream — partial output kept". caption visible to screen readers at all times. for mobile, long-press shows a mini menu: "Keep partial" (default) and "Discard". avoid hidden gestures as only discovery.

vivian: agreed. also proposing a tiny "delta" badge on the token pill during streaming that shows +N new tokens since last stable count; it animates in then fades. for a11y we should aria-hide the animating delta and only announce the stable total after debounce 180ms with aria-live="polite". final events like "generation complete" use assertive.

mark: delta badge is neat. accessibility nit: ensure the token pill hit target is >=44px and the pill has a visible focus ring (2px outline) in both themes. respect prefers-reduced-motion for the fade.

tom: question about token announcements: NVDA and VoiceOver both spiked with frequent updates. debounce 180ms seems okay. also when the client reconciles with server token count show a small spinner and set the number aria-hidden until stable.

isabel: prompt library changes: add quick-preview on hover/focus that shows the prompt content and an "Insert (Enter)" hint. keyboard: arrow nav, Enter to insert, Space to pin. pinned prompts sync across devices (new product ask) so we need to mention that in the hover card: "Pinned (synced)".
